verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Superhuman connects to existing Gmail/Outlook accounts and can switch between them, but there is no mention of importing mail history or contacts from a different provider (e.g., Yahoo, iCloud) or from another client's local archive/export file. Since Superhuman only works as a client on top of already-connected Gmail/Outlook mailboxes, no dedicated 'import' or migration tooling for switchers is documented.
